title: Reinventing a Festival After COVID
organization: New York Japanese Saturday School — Akimatsuri

summary.en: A school community festival that had run on food sales for years came back after two COVID years with food, meat and after-school operation off the table. As volunteer chair I moved the revenue engine to games — concepts, booths, brand, customer flow, operations — and iterated it yearly. Game revenue grew more than 3× over three years.
summary.jp: 食の売上で回っていた学校祭が、COVID で 2 年止まった。戻ったときには食も肉も使えない。収益の柱をゲームに移し、3 年かけて 3 倍以上にした。ボランティアの持ち回りの役。

creative.en: Experience · Brand · Operations · Revenue. One identity — the character 祭 and the school's motto 知行合一 — carried through logo, patterns, noren, signage, a treasure-card system that ties every booth together, and eleven games designed so that the rules can be learned by watching.
creative.jp: 体験・ブランド・運営・収益。「祭」の文字と校訓「知行合一」を軸にした。ロゴから暖簾、宝物カードまで 1 つの世界観で通し、見て分かる 11 のゲームを設計した。

business.en: A business-model transformation under hard constraints: the old revenue pillar (donated food, parent volunteers from the food industry) was gone. Games had been three small booths. Rebuilt as the main engine, game revenue grew more than 3× over three years and profitability became far more stable.
business.jp: コロナで食という収益の柱が消えた。もともと 3 つの屋台だったゲームを主力に据え直した。3 年で売上は 3 倍以上に伸び、収益の安定度も上がった。

venture.en: 0→1 inside an existing institution: no budget line for this, no staff, 110+ volunteers who show up once a year. Design the games, test them on kids, cut what fails, keep what works, do it again next year.
venture.jp: 既存の組織の中での 0→1。予算枠も専任スタッフもなく、年 1 回集まる 110 人超のボランティアだけ。ゲームを設計し、子どもで試し、外れは切り、翌年また繰り返す。

mine: Took the chair role with one strategic goal: shift the revenue pillar from food to games
Researched Japanese ennichi festival games and set design criteria (learnable by watching, 1–2 minute rounds, kindergarten to high school)
Game concepts and the expansion of the game portfolio from 3 inherited booths to 11+ original games
Designed, prototyped and tested individual game experiences, some over several yearly iterations
Booth concepts, customer flow, signage and wayfinding
Festival brand identity — 祭 character, 知行合一 motto, patterns, noren, environmental graphics
Operations, budget and revenue thinking; coordinated 110+ volunteers
Invited students to propose game ideas and co-designed them with adult volunteers
team: A small build crew constructed the games from the designs
Parent volunteers ran every station on the day; a separate team managed the shopping area
Students proposed and helped validate new game ideas

narrative.situation: Before COVID the festival made roughly $10K+ a year, most of it from food, with parent volunteers from the food industry supplying donated or discounted goods. Games were three small booths.
narrative.problem: COVID stopped the festival for two years. When it returned the old model could not: food restrictions, meat no longer viable, after-school operation unavailable, the previous revenue structure disrupted.
narrative.opportunity: Make games the revenue engine — and make the festival feel like a place again, not a fundraiser.
constraints: Volunteer-run, once a year, no staff
built: 11+ original games (Flying Chicken, Korinto, Guru-guru Target, Swinging Coin Drop, Superball Sukui, Fishing Master, Kata-Nuki…)
Festival identity: logo, patterns, noren, environmental graphics
Treasure exchange card tying the booths into one system

business: Game revenue grew more than 3× over three years
organizational: The festival's operating model no longer depends on food supply or food-industry volunteers

_notes: The case-study page reports '3× revenue growth 2022→2024' for the festival; Takao's own framing is 'game-related revenue grew more than 3×'. The metric is recorded with the narrower, safer wording and confidence 'approximate'.
The page says '3→11' in the stat block and '11–12' in prose; the stat block figure is used.

cardKind.jp: パターン · アイデンティティ

cardLine.en: COVID took the food stalls, so the festival ran on games instead. Revenue tripled.
cardLine.jp: コロナで模擬店が消え、祭りはゲームで回るようになった。収益は 3 倍以上。
